assumptionsAndLimits: All six fictional cases recur at month 12. Open dots show scheduled blood draws every two months; filled teal dots show first qualifying positives. A–D have completed earlier-positive intervals of 2, 4, 6 and 8 months. E and F have no earlier positive. The selected median is (4 + 6) ÷ 2 = 5 months among four cases; it excludes the two detection failures. These numbers are invented teaching data, not a study estimate or future prediction.
